install strategy: macOS uses Homebrew, Linux reuses the package-manager Snipaste command or installs the official SHA-256-pinned x86_64 AppImage from config/bootstrap/snipaste.tsv. mac-setup owns the lowercase launcher, Linux menu entry and initial mutable config copy; native config, history and licensing remain local. See docs/snipaste.md for update/removal.

ferstar/gestures; build with cargo install --git and --rev --locked against local libxdo; upstream owns binary and generated user service, mac-setup Linux sync owns only config/gestures/gestures.kdl. Local ~/.local build and XFCE autostart/drop-in are recorded in docs/gestures.md; sync does not publish service overrides. See that document for reinstall, reload and disabling both autostart paths.
jordansissel/xdotool; local source build installs binary and libxdo.so.3 under ~/.local for gestures. Rebuild from pinned source as documented in docs/gestures.md; not installed by sync.
